query: For the paper "Toward Interpretable Topic Discovery via Anchored Correlation Explanation" (arXiv: 1606.07043), answer this question: On which corpora do they evaluate on?

drafts: 他们在两个语料库上进行评估：20 Newsgroups 的 soc.religion.christianity 类别 [2][12]，以及临床笔记语料库 Obesity 2008（Obesity Challenge）数据 [2][13][14]。

cited_sources.text: We present preliminary experimental results on two text corpora (including a cor- pus of clinical notes), showing that anchors can be used to discover topics that are more speciﬁc and relevant. What is more, we demonstrate the potential for this framework to perform weakly supervised learning in settings where labeling documents is prohibitively expensive (Chen et al., 2013; Agarwal et al., 2016). With respect to interpretable machine learning, our con- tributions are twofold.

F1Anch F1Unsup Anchors Jesus 0.42 0.45 God 0.49 0.43 0.55 Jesus,Christian 0.45 Naive Bayes 0.75 Table 2. F1 scores on soc.religion.christianity. Table 2 compares the classiﬁcation performance of Unsupervised and Anchored CorEx on soc.religion.christianity category from 20 Newsgroups for different choices of anchors.

Table 3 shows the Macro-AUC and F1 scores (averaged across all diseases) on the Obesity Challenge data for the ﬁnal anchored CorEx model and a Naive Bayes (NB) baseline, in which we train a separate classiﬁer for each Obstructive Sleep Apnea AUC Topic AUC 0.600 use, drug, complication, allergy, 0.686 sodium, infection, furosemide, docusate, shortness of breath, esomeprazole 0.762 use, complication, drug, allergy, sodium, 0.546 infection, furosemide, docusate, shortness of breath, obstructive sleep apnea sleep apnea, obstructive sleep apnea, 0.757 0.826 oxygen, duoneb, desaturation, singulair, pulmonary hypertension, hypoxemia, pap smear, vicodin Classiﬁer Macro-AUC Macro-F1 Naive Bayes 0.7120 0.4638 Anchored CorEx 0.7445 0.5328 Table 3. Classiﬁcation performance on Obesity 2008. disease.

Surprisingly, Anchored CorEx outperforms Naive Bayes (NB) by a large margin. Of course, Anchored CorEx is not a replacement for supervised learning: NB beats Anchored CorEx on 20 Newsgroups and does not represent a “strong” baseline for Obesity 2008 (teams scored above 0.7 in Macro-F1 during the competition). It is nonetheless remarkable that Anchored CorEx performs as well as it does given that it is fundamentally unsupervised.
